notes.text: Ascend from floor 1: only my 4 hand cards were shuffled back in ('Red shuffles 4 card(s) back in'). Red still shows exhaust 5, discard 6 (incl. new Tag Team); Gray exhaust 9, discard 3. Rulebook section 10: 'Shuffle ALL your cards into your deck, including your hand, discard pile, AND exhaust pile.' Expected both to have 0 exhaust and 0 discard, Red deck 17ish, Gray 17ish. Either the engine or the rulebook is out of date; I expected the heal. Gray at 8 live after floor 1 is fragile.

Second Ascend (floor 2): same result. Only hand cards shuffle back in ('Red shuffles 6 card(s) back in'), discard stays discard (Red 3, Gray 5), exhaust stays (10 each). Rulebook section 10 says shuffle ALL, including discard and exhaust, and 'Cards you lose do not come back' in About conflicts with it. Question for the designer: which is current? In play, Stim and Stitch-Em-Ups were my only repair, and stamina after floor 2 is Red 14 / Gray 14 from a 12-card start.

Gray played I Know Kung Fu (text: 'every time a Scramble card is played this turn, you may draw a card') and then two Coil Of Cable (Scramble 3 each). No draw was offered either time, and Gray's hand went 3 to 2 to 1. Expected two 'Draw 1 card?' prompts like Pocket Dynamo gave. Either 'Scramble card' means something narrower than a card with a Scramble stat, or Kung Fu did not trigger. Question for the designer: what counts as a Scramble card here?

Hack the Doors (Peek 3) on the Good Stuff pool: the CLI showed Emergency Breaker, Duct Tape & Wire, Scrap Magnet and only offered 'order' (put all 3 back). Rulebook Peek X: 'Discard any number of them, then put the rest back in any order.' I expected a chance to discard some. Is discard from a Stuff pool meant to be offered, and where do discarded cards go (Scrapyard? bottom?)?
